senses.gloss: m.(b. h. wing, v. אָבַר; cmp. כַּף,
limb, part.—א׳ מן החי a part cut off from a living animal.
town quarter, projecting outskirts (v. אָבַר Pi. 2).—א׳ א׳ limb by limb; piecemeal.
